@@leveling2@@ {{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@ {{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@ {{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@ {{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@ {{{leveling6}}}@@range@@ {{{range}}}@@radius@@ {{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@ {{{effect radius}}}@@width@@ {{{width}}}@@speed@@ {{{speed}}}@@casttime@@ 0.25 – 0.175 (based on '''bonus''' attack speed)[[Category:Debug]]@@cost@@ 28 / 46 / 64 / 82 / 100 (+ 20% AD)@@cooldown@@ 11 / 10 / 9 / 8 / 7@@targeting@@ Unit@@damagetype@@ True@@spellshield@@ True@@projectile@@ {{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * The health cost is equal to 40% of ''Reckless Swing's'' true damage value. * ''Reckless Swing'' can be cast even if '''Olaf''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost. ** As with all abilities with health costs, ''Reckless Swing'' will not reduce '''Olaf's''' health below 1. * ''Reckless Swing's'' health refund is considered a [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] therefore it is affected by healing modifiers. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable). ** '''Olaf''' will also not receive the benefits from killing an enemy if this canceling takes place very shortly before the attack hits the invalidated target, but ''Reckless Swing's'' effect will be consumed.(bug)@@
